title: Squircle: build your app inside your app!
summary: Anshu Chimala demonstrates sending a recorded UI bug from inside his native iPhone app, letting a Mac-hosted T3 Code agent return a signed build, and installing it from the phone. An iOS team can try a development-only feedback overlay while keeping release exports free of the agent UI; this early-alpha demo does not establish reliable merge gates or rollback recovery.
takeaway: Attach a screen recording where the bug occurs, inspect the resulting signed build on the phone, and verify that the development overlay is absent from distribution exports.

media.title: Anshu Chimala reports a UI bug inside his iPhone app and installs the returned build
